name: voku/php-runtime-audit
description: Local-first PHP runtime and patch evidence audit with AI-ready remediation plans.

scripts.analyse: phpstan analyse --level=max --no-progress src/AuditProfiles src/Evidence src/RuntimeInventory src/Advisories src/Remediation bin/php-runtime-audit bin/php-runtime-audit-evidence bin/php-runtime-audit-inventory bin/php-runtime-audit-report tests/AuditProfiles tests/Evidence tests/RuntimeInventory tests/Advisories tests/Remediation tests/fixtures/runtime/assert-disposable-report.php
scripts.format-check: php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS src/AuditProfiles && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS src/Evidence && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS src/RuntimeInventory && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS src/Advisories && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS src/Remediation && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS bin/php-runtime-audit && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS bin/php-runtime-audit-evidence && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS bin/php-runtime-audit-inventory && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS bin/php-runtime-audit-report && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS tests/AuditProfiles && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS tests/Evidence && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS tests/RuntimeInventory && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS tests/Advisories && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS tests/Remediation && php-cs-fixer fix --dry-run --diff --using-cache=no --rules=@PER-CS tests/fixtures/runtime/assert-disposable-report.php
